{"skills":[{"name":"AFN 状态快照解析","description":"按 GLOBAL/NODES/EDGES/VEHICLES/CONSIGNMENTS/INCIDENTS_ACTIVE 六段结构解析并校验 AFN 仿真状态快照，供后续规则判定使用。","prompt":"给定某一 tick 的 AFN 仿真状态快照文本，按六段结构（GLOBAL、NODES、EDGES、VEHICLES、CONSIGNMENTS、INCIDENTS_ACTIVE）逐段解析为可查询的状态对象，并核对各段字段是否齐全。仅做状态读取与字段完整性检查，不执行动作决策或冲突裁决。","asset_type":"knowledge_reference","asset_node_id":"knowledge_reference_node","granularity":"session","objective":"将结构化状态快照正确解析为可查询的仿真状态对象","domain":"交通仿真","task_family":"状态表示","method_family":"结构化快照解析","stage":"状态读取","applicable_signals":["提供的是某一 tick 的完整状态快照","需要按六段结构读取状态字段"],"intervention_moves":["识别并切分六个段：GLOBAL、NODES、EDGES、VEHICLES、CONSIGNMENTS、INCIDENTS_ACTIVE","解析 GLOBAL 段的 TimeTick、ScenarioName、ScoreSoFar","解析 NODES 段的 NodeID、NodeType、PackagesAtNode、ParkingVehicles","解析 EDGES 段的 EdgeID、Status（OPEN/CLOSED）、Occupancy（VehicleID, RemainingTravelTime）","汇总为可查询状态对象并输出字段完整性检查结果"],"contraindications":["仅有单条边或单辆车的局部信息","需要执行动作决策而非读取状态"],"triggers":["需要读取某一 tick 的完整仿真状态","需要核对快照各段字段是否齐全"],"workflow_steps":["确认输入为某一 tick 的完整状态快照","按六段结构切分快照","逐段解析字段：GLOBAL（TimeTick、ScenarioName、ScoreSoFar）；NODES（NodeID、NodeType、PackagesAtNode、ParkingVehicles）；EDGES（EdgeID、Status、Occupancy）","组装为可查询状态对象","核对各段字段是否齐全并记录缺失项"],"constraints":["仅做状态读取与解析，不执行动作决策","不进行规则冲突裁决","输入须为完整快照而非局部信息"],"cautions":["ScoreSoFar 可能为暂定值，解析时保留原值不做推断","EDGES 的 Occupancy 项为 (VehicleID, RemainingTravelTime) 形式，需成对解析"],"output_contract":["解析后的六段状态对象及字段完整性检查结果"],"examples":[{"input":"GLOBAL
TimeTick: 0
ScenarioName: Morning Rush
ScoreSoFar: 0","output":"GLOBAL 段解析为 {TimeTick: 0, ScenarioName: "Morning Rush", ScoreSoFar: 0}","notes":"GLOBAL 段字段示例"},{"input":"NODES
N1 DEPOT PackagesAtNode: [C1, C2] ParkingVehicles: [V1, V2]
N2 HUB PackagesAtNode: [] ParkingVehicles: []","output":"NODES 段解析为节点列表，含 NodeID、NodeType、PackagesAtNode、ParkingVehicles","notes":"NODES 段字段示例"}],"tags":["交通仿真","状态表示","快照解析","AFN"],"confidence":0.7,"risk_class":"low","support_ids":["8b559934-ba0e-5863-aa9b-4509bcdacc62"],"source_draft_ids":["b148d44c-2bd2-5ec7-97ad-b37e2bbaf6c8"]}]}
